title: Spin with more inertia
hook: Change moment of inertia and predict angular momentum.
misconception: angular momentum stays fixed when moment of inertia doubles.
objective: Apply L = Iω to compare angular momentum when moment of inertia changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With rotation at fixed angular speed about the same axis, L = Iω. When moment of inertia doubles, angular momentum becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model L = Iω; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider rotation at fixed angular speed about the same axis, with a nonzero initial result. If moment of inertia triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on angular momentum?
recall.why: Apply L = Iω under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
